interpretation.order: Assess main_acquisition first, then post_withdrawal retention and after_return performance.
interpretation.contrast: Within the same seed, architecture, coverage, family, condition, checkpoint and horizon: new shrink0 minus borrowed shrink2e-4.
interpretation.replicate: Three independently trained seeds; forks, actors, families and ticks do not add replicates.
interpretation.denominators: Request maturity, right censoring, idle opportunities, conditional content and cue/first-legal populations stay separate.
interpretation.borrowing: Old 216 frozen probe records are re-audited and matched to immutable audited CSV values; no old training or evaluation is rerun.
limits: A low score before withdrawal is acquisition failure, not evidence of forgetting an acquired skill.
Narrow long_both is outside its training timing support.
Shrink also changes capacity and subsequent own-action trajectories; this is a whole-update-policy contrast, not pure topology.
Paired frozen forks retain different inherited hidden/world states and matured populations.
